prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 4 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1483; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with reported headache, dizziness, and intermittent difficulty concentrating. Over four visits, the injury was evaluated and managed conservatively. The reported symptoms are consistent with the mechanism and force of the collision. Examination findings were partly supportive of a concussive injury, including tenderness on palpation and mild balance disturbance on tandem gait, while other neurological screening tests, including cranial nerve assessment, pupillary response, and strength testing, were within normal limits. Recovery has been somewhat slower than typically seen for this injury, and symptom management and graded activity guidance were extended accordingly. No prior injury to the same region has been reported in the available history. Billing records for the four encounters reflect single charges for each service, with no duplicate or repeated billing observed. Ongoing follow-up is recommended to monitor symptom resolution and return-to-activity progress.
